chain.question: How much / how many / at what scale?
How must the parts or actors relate?
What environment or setting constrains it?
What form is required or implied?
What systems are needed to realize the form and functions?
How will we know the result satisfies the purpose?

entry_rule: Enter at the lowest stage already sufficiently resolved while preserving the parent purpose.
exit_rule: Hand downstream only when the requested resolution and acceptance invariants are explicit enough for production representation to be chosen without changing intent.
